preconditions.description: The integer l must be between 1 and 10^800 inclusive.
The integer r must be between l and 10^800 inclusive.
The integer n must be between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must contain the maximum number of modest substrings.
The second line of output must contain a string of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(int(sub) >= l and int(sub) <= r for sub in generate_substrings(stdout.split('\n')[1]))
postconditions.description: All substrings of the output string must be modest integers.
The output string must be the lexicographically smallest string that satisfies the conditions.
